ports.modifications: 2026-11-18: adapted forward shader subset from Slang to GLSL 330. Accept already transformed OpenGL eye-space coordinates/covariance and a bottom-left pixel principal point. Keep the asymmetric ray clamp and opacity-dependent extent cap; use a cancellation-resistant eigen discriminant. GSW retains its own values and semantics for low-pass, cutoff, centre, blending and depth.
dependencies: GLSL 330 core on the existing Qt OpenGL context
ports.gswTarget: GaussianSceneWorkbench (resources.qrc; NativeViewport::drawGaussianCloud only in the opted-in compatible live task path)

ports.usage: Only the numeric inputs to the extent formula are used. No include, shader module, or project build syntax copied.
Provenance only. This port adds no NVIDIA libraries and does not claim or expand this exception.
Native selection and Qt OpenGL lifecycle. GSW's own preview transport, camera transform and rendering infrastructure are retained.
